Entry Swearing Allegiance Kneeling, shaking hands, reciting an oath or making a promise before God are rituals that turn a private relationship into a public responsibility. Nobles know that witnesses and words are equally important, while soldiers remember receiving food and flags; oaths can maintain order and make betrayal seem particularly heavy. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
